text:
jordan: Quick note — for Thu ARB (10:00am PT) I'm proposing we try a compact sync format (45m) + rotating facilitator swap. Goal: faster RFC triage and clearer pre-read expectations. See proposed agenda below. Thoughts? @here :calendar:

maria: Love it. Helps with backlog. What does facilitator need to prep?

jordan: Facilitator responsibilities: 1) pull pre-read list, 2) run 6m lightning per RFC, 3) own slide share + decisions doc. I'll drop a checklist in thread. :memo:

kevin: :raised_hand: I can fac next week (Thu 3/26). Can we add a 5m "rollover items" buffer?

jordan: Yes — added. Also setting pre-read cutoff = 24h before meeting. If no pre-read, RFC goes to triage pool. Calendar invite updated: https://calendar.redwood.com/e/arb-compact-3-26

rina: Quick Q — timezone check: 10am PT is 6pm UTC? I can do, but prefer earlier for APAC folks.

sam: We can alternate facilitators every other week to help APAC. Suggest we carve one "APAC-friendly" deep-dive slot every 3 weeks.

kevin: Fine by me.

jordan: Sample agenda:
```
1) Quick housekeep (5m) - facilitator
2) Lightning RFCs (3 x 6m + 2m decision each)
3) Deep-dive slot (15m)
4) Rollover / action items (5m)
```

maria: Can we use a tiny template for RFC deck: TL;DR, impact, rollback plan, metrics? Saves time.

jordan: Yep — will paste template here. Also adding a poll to pick facilitator rotation: https://polls.redwood.com/arb-facilitator

dev-bot: Reminder set: pre-read cutoff 24h before event. I'll DM facilitator 2h before to check slides. :robot_face:

rina: :eyes: I added our pending "KV-cache alignments" RFC to pre-reads (link in calendar invite).

sam: If anyone's doing a canary rollout RFC, please flag "requires dedicated capacity" so we can loop in Dedicated owners ahead of time.

kevin: Accepted — I'll update my RFC with capacity note.

maria: :thumbsup: LGTM. Thanks Jordan for organizing.

jordan: Thanks all. Kevin — I'll mark you as facilitator for 3/26 in the invite. If anything changes, swap via the poll. Closing — see you Thu!
